svg.title: RTX PRO 6000 · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · one pod

cc:Work.dc:title: RTX PRO 6000 · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · one pod
cc:Work.dc:description: On one pod, prefill CUDA graphs put stock SGLang DFlash2 and both AX routes ahead of stock vLLM DFlash2 on code and math at eight clients; the AX tree leads every workload at one client.

g.text: 128 greedy output tokens per request · 8 prompts at C1, 24 at C8 per workload · two servers per lane · cute-dsl FP4 GEMMs
